name: policy_finetune_pilot_2026_09_20_r1

visual.scope: Existing paper RGB state-adapter LAPO/LAOM policies; not official end-to-end pixel baseline reproduction

mpe.selection: Same budget-internal validation episodes 0,4,...,28 and evaluation every 25 updates; same fit/val split and decoder RNG as original. Joint history/decoder checkpoint selected together.

qualification: 7 two-update smokes; 35 frozen weight/fit parity checks; 35 common-episode replays before new full training; all new grounding frozen before evaluation
statistics: Exploratory fixed-budget pilot; paired five upstream seeds. Visual four within-arm finetuning gains one Holm family; MPE three gains another. MIF/BC and between-method comparisons descriptive. Report all signs, t95 and exact two-sided sign-flip p; min p=.0625.
scope: No new frontends, latent encoder training, action labels, tasks or agent counts; observation-only upstream checkpoints unchanged. Downstream history plus decoder supervised adaptation only. No performance-dependent tuning or seed selection.
